Done. I've set up automatic sync for you:

**What I created:**
- `scripts/setup-auto-sync.ps1` — PowerShell script that configures Windows Task Scheduler
- `scripts/sync.bat` — Wrapper that Task Scheduler will execute (created when you run the setup)

**How it works:**
1. Runs at system startup automatically
2. Repeats every 60 minutes (adjust the `$triggerInterval` variable if needed)
3. Continues running even when you're logged out

**To activate:**
```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/setup-auto-sync.ps1
```

After reboot, your sync will start automatically and run on schedule. Check the `data/feed.log` file to verify it's working—you'll see new timestamps added even if nobody's watching.
